Construction Services Available Throughout Massachusetts

Masonry & Hardscapes

Our masonry and hardscape services enhance outdoor spaces throughout Massachusetts with custom patios, walkways, retaining walls, outdoor fireplaces, stone features, and complete outdoor living areas. We combine quality materials with skilled craftsmanship to create durable and attractive landscapes designed for long-term enjoyment.

Asphalt Paving

We provide residential and commercial asphalt paving services throughout Massachusetts including new driveways, parking lots, resurfacing, repairs, sealcoating, crack filling, and pavement maintenance. Our team uses proven techniques and quality materials to create durable surfaces built to withstand New England weather.

Excavation & Site Development

Our excavation and site development services prepare properties for construction through grading, drainage solutions, land clearing, foundation excavation, utility work, and site preparation. We help residential and commercial projects establish a strong foundation from the beginning.

Snow & Ice Management

Our commercial snow and ice management services help Massachusetts properties remain safe and accessible during winter weather. Services include snow removal, parking lot plowing, sidewalk clearing, ice management, snow hauling, and post-storm cleanup.

Frequently Asked Questions About Our Service Areas

Do you work on residential and commercial projects?

Yes. S. Phaneuf & Associates provides construction services for homeowners, businesses, and commercial properties throughout Massachusetts.

How long does asphalt paving take?

Most residential asphalt paving projects are completed within 1 to 3 days depending on the size, preparation requirements, and complexity of the project.

Do you offer snow removal services?

Yes. S. Phaneuf & Associates provides commercial snow and ice management services throughout Massachusetts to help keep properties safe and accessible during winter weather.

What is the best time of year for asphalt paving?

The best time for asphalt paving is typically during the warmer months of spring, summer, and early fall when temperatures are ideal for proper installation.

How can I maintain my asphalt driveway?

Regular maintenance including sealcoating, cleaning, and repairing cracks can help extend the life of an asphalt driveway and maintain its appearance.

Do you provide free estimates?

Yes. We provide free consultations and estimates for masonry, hardscaping, asphalt paving, excavation, site development, and snow management projects.

What areas does S. Phaneuf & Associates serve?

We serve homeowners and businesses throughout Central and Eastern Massachusetts including Greater Boston communities and surrounding areas.

What does the site development process include?

Our site development services include consultation, excavation, grading, drainage solutions, and preparing properties for construction.

How do you ensure quality construction work?

We focus on quality materials, proven construction methods, and experienced workmanship to deliver durable results for residential and commercial projects.

Do you provide drainage solutions?

Yes. We evaluate drainage needs during excavation and construction projects and provide solutions designed to improve water flow and protect your property.
